```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(snakecase)
library(fs)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

source(here("R/functions.R"))
```

```{r}
hr_data <- read_all("HR.csv.gz") |>
  get_participant_id() |>
  summarise_by_datetime()

ibi_data <- read_all("IBI.csv.gz") |>
  get_participant_id() |>
  summarise_by_datetime()

temp_data <- read_all("TEMP.csv.gz") |>
  get_participant_id() |>
  summarise_by_datetime()

bvp_data <- read_all("BVP.csv.gz") |>
  get_participant_id() |>
  summarise_by_datetime()

eda_data <- read_all("EDA.csv.gz") |>
  get_participant_id() |>
  summarise_by_datetime()
```

```{r}
survey_tidy <- here::here("data-raw/nurses-stress/survey-results.csv.gz") |>
  read() |>
  tidy_survey_dates()

survey_long <- survey_tidy |>
  survey_to_long()
```

## Joining datasets Exercise 22.5
```{r}
nurses_stress <- survey_long %>%
  full_join(survey_tidy) %>%
  full_join(hr_data) %>%
  full_join(ibi_data) %>%
  full_join(temp_data) %>%
  full_join(bvp_data) %>%
  full_join(eda_data)

nurses_stress %>%
  arrange(id, collection_datetime) %>%
  view()

nurses_stress
```
